sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and mystery drama syndication, Lon Clark in three cases of *Nick Carter, Master Detective* including *The Ragoff Brooch*, serialized thriller *The Drums of Death* (Part 3), and *The Rodeo Murders* (1943, 1944, 1953), Tommy Dorsey and Sy Oliver on *Fame and Fortune* (1946), Ed Begley in *The Killing at Lafayette Place* (1956), and Orson Welles and Tallulah Bankhead in Shakespeare's *Twelfth Night* (1937–1956):
